summary: rcf define validate refuses a new or amended live criterion without verification (base ref through git), reports the rest and prints a sweep worklist; rcf audit coverage adds verification, expectedEnd and now per criterion and per spec; CI passes --base; the round's DEFINE moves the 0.37.0 interim tags onto the field.
approach: A verification pass in src/define/validate-findings.js with a base reader over git show; --report verification in src/cli/validate.js; end-state derivation in the coverage model and its three formatters; ci.yml passes --base on pull requests. The tag move is a test-author DEFINE act through rcf define update, after the schema slice's pin is on main.
deliverables: src/define/validate-findings.js and src/cli/validate.js: the verification rule, --base and --report verification
src/cli/coverage.js and its formatters: verification, expectedEnd and now
Code Nodes for every criterion of this REQ; CHANGELOG lines

rcf/separation.json for this repository: a coverage-goldens generator (node bin/rcf.js audit coverage --format table > test/query/fixtures/coverage.table.txt and --format json > test/query/fixtures/coverage.json; checkedBy test/query/fixtures.test.js), because coverage shows now from this slice on (test-author, in this round's DEFINE)
